metadata.author: Replicant Partners
metadata.description: Observes multi-party conversations and evaluates collaborative discourse coherence using Thagard's Theory of Explanatory Coherence (TEC). Computes global coherence score, per-principle diagnostics, and actionable feedback via connectionist constraint-satisfaction (ECHO).
sample_queries: Evaluate the coherence of claims about AI replacing software engineers
Check logical consistency of arguments for cryptocurrency regulation
Assess whether recent climate policy proposals are internally consistent
